title: Library upgrade in a deploy changes JSON number serialization, breaking downstream parsers
source_note: Failure pattern (a dependency version bump inside a routine deploy silently changes an output format, so downstream consumers that parse it start failing) is a recurring class in the danluu/post-mortems collection. All services, versions, commit hashes, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~09:47 UTC the mobile apps are showing wrong prices and some orders are being rejected. Backend error rates on order-api look normal. A pricing-service deploy went out at 09:45. No infra changes.

signal_lines.msg: json-lib 3.0 now serializes decimals as strings by default (was numbers)
parsing pricing-service response: expected number for field 'unit_price', got string "12.99"; falling back to 0
orders rejected: computed total 0.00 fails validation; ~30% of orders affected
pricing-service rolled back to the previous build; downstream parsing recovered

ground_truth.root_cause: The pricing-service deploy 3f4g5h6 bumped its JSON library from 2.8 to 3.0. Version 3.0 changed the default serialization of decimal values from JSON numbers to JSON strings. order-api parses pricing-service responses expecting numbers for fields like unit_price; it now received strings, failed to parse them, and fell back to 0, so computed order totals became 0.00 and ~30% of orders failed validation and were rejected. The change was invisible in pricing-service's own metrics because it still returned 200s. Recovery on rollback.
evidence_path: deploy 3f4g5h6 to pricing-service at 09:45 bumps json-lib 2.8 -> 3.0
pricing-service INFO: json-lib 3.0 serializes decimals as strings by default (was numbers)
order-api ERROR: expected number for 'unit_price', got string "12.99"; falling back to 0
order-api computed totals become 0.00 and ~30% of orders are rejected on validation
downstream parsing recovers once pricing-service is rolled back
ground_truth.fix: Roll back pricing-service (done). Pin json-lib or configure it to keep numeric decimals, add a contract test on the pricing-service response schema that downstream consumers run in CI, and treat dependency-bump deploys as behavior-changing.
